description: This file defines the OrderProvider class for managing order-related operations in a Flutter application, including placing orders, fetching order history, and updating order status.

classes.name: OrderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages order data and operations such as placing orders, fetching history, and updating status.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with the provided cart items, inserts it into the order list, updates the current order, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: fetchOrderHistory
methods.description: Placeholder method to fetch order history from an API; currently calls notifyListeners without external data.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing order identified by orderId and notifies listeners.
